description: This file defines the Product model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically handling database interactions related to products such as retrieval, updates, and associated data like categories, discounts, options, images, and related products.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: A model class responsible for database operations related to products, including fetching, updating, and managing product data and related entities.

methods.name: editQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product in the database.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific product by its ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products based on various filtering and sorting criteria.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Returns the total count of products matching given filters.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Fetches category details for a product within a specific category.

methods.name: getTotalCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of categories associated with a product within a specific category.

methods.name: getCodes
methods.description: Fetches product code records associated with a product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attribute groups and their attributes for a product.

methods.name: editOptionQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product option value.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific product option.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options available for a product.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific product option value.

methods.name: getOptionValues
methods.description: Fetches all option values for a specific product option.

methods.name: getDiscounts
methods.description: Retrieves discount records applicable to a product.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Fetches images associated with a product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details for a product and subscription plan.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription plans associated with a product.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches layout ID specific to a product for display purposes.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related products for a given product.

methods.name: getSpecials
methods.description: Fetches products that are marked as having special offers.

methods.name: getTotalSpecials
methods.description: Returns the total count of products with specials.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Creates a new product report entry (e.g., for tracking views or issues).
